description: 多片同规格量贩暖通滤网，靠拦截机制屏与尺寸构造信息图收口囤货转化

styleLock.direction: clean HVAC value-pack consumery commerce, flat colour-block graphic screens alternating with bright packshots
styleLock.backgroundSystem: seamless pure white #FFFFFF for packshots, spec flat lays and macro plates, stone-grey graphic fields #D8DDDB for mechanism screens, deep green #0F7A3D and teal #12A3C0 used as flat colour-block fields for structure, comparison and closing layouts; real painted drywall only inside the one installation photograph
styleLock.lightingSystem: bright even high-key studio light at 5600K from the front-left with a soft fill on the shadow side and one soft contact shadow under every unit; flat shadowless graphic light at 5600K on colour-block screens with one consistent upper-left direction; macro and structure views lit with a cool low-intensity skimming sweep
styleLock.surfaceSystem: seamless white studio sweep #FFFFFF, matte stone-grey plates #D8DDDB beneath detail and macro views, printed board and pleated media textures kept unretouched, real drywall and a metal grille housing only inside the installation scene
styleLock.typography: modern geometric sans-serif, one family only, oversized headline bands, one short label row per element, generous margins, every word left as a blank slot or a callout placeholder
styleLock.iconSystem: flat thin-line pictograms in single-stroke teal #12A3C0 or white inside blank circular chips, plain check shapes and open-ended leader lines, no gradients, no shading, no captions
styleLock.presentationRules: pack upright and square to the frame on graphic fields, identical scale between paired panels and between lineup packs, filter media shown at the same face-on or edge-on attitude, one soft contact shadow under every unit, product never clipped
noDrift: no photographic backgrounds on graphic screens
no inconsistent light direction between paired panels
no real brand marks, origin flags, certification artwork, grade letters or rating numbers
no invented figures inside parameter bands, count windows, leader lines or date tabs
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent clean HVAC value-pack ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of seamless pure white #FFFFFF, stone grey #D8DDDB, deep green #0F7A3D and one teal accent #12A3C0; cool neutral lighting with a bright even high-key front-left key at 5600K plus one soft contact shadow for packshots and flat shadowless graphic light with one consistent upper-left direction on colour-block screens; modern geometric sans-serif with oversized headline bands and one short label row per element; flat thin-line pictograms in single-stroke teal or white inside blank circular chips; flat colour-block graphic screens and bright packshots, with photographic inserts used only in the pain-point cards and the one installation scene; stable upright square-to-frame product scale and identical scale between paired panels; no colour palette changes, no mixed fonts, no photographic backgrounds on graphic screens, no inconsistent lighting, no real brand marks or badge artwork, no invented numbers.

provenance.notes: 逐图事实：001 白底正面包装主图，绿色边框与青蓝色带、等级徽章位、污染物图标点阵、右下角同规格滤网叠放与一条空白更换日期贴；002 尺寸教学信息屏，标称与实测双栏、长宽深三向引线；003 新版无外盒说明屏，三条勾选说明加一枚圆形放大视窗展示褶层与支撑网；004 机制屏，侧 3/4 立放滤网、上游灰色颗粒群与下游三条出风箭头，下方等级飘带与污染物图标阵列（启用与未启用两态）；005 安装教学屏，左格一名男子抬手把滤网推入顶部回风口（露脸），右列三步编号说明；006 双栏对比屏，左栏绿到青的自家折纹滤网与四行勾选主张、右栏灰底无褶普通滤材与四行对照、中间一列圆形图标章；007 品牌横幅加三行勾选利益点、右侧一对男女与一只狗的门口合影（两人均露脸）、左下多包同族包装堆叠；008 白底正面滤面平拍，褶层与纸框；009 白底背面平拍，菱形钢丝支撑网。品类判定依据：实物为无电机、无电加热的替换式暖通与中央空调回风过滤网，配合暖气炉与回风箱使用，属家装暖通耗材，故 L1 逐字取「家装灯具」、L2 逐字取「建材」；未取「家用电器」（非电器整机，无电机与电加热），未取「家居日用/纸品清洁」（非清洁耗材），未取「五金」（非工具与紧固件），源站类目仅作检索线索；与库内单片装滤网同 leaf，本套以多片量贩叠装与囤货收口在 slug 与语义上区分，视觉体系无需差异化。已剥离内容：源品牌字标与系列名、原产国旗角标与第三方认证标志图形、效率等级字母与全部数值、全部标称与实测尺寸数值、更换周期月数、净化百分比与微粒粒径数字、褶皱密度与寿命对比数字、呼吸疾病与功效主张、原图英文标题与正文原句、平台与社会证明类背书字样、005 与 007 模特的面容与身份（改为颈部以下裁切与仅露手部）。所有数值与等级一律改为空白参数带、空计数窗、无字引线、空白日期贴与未填充的对照栏，产品一律以 {product} 占位，可复用的只是色块版式、机位、光位与分镜结构。
